description.value: 88 Supermarket is a Canadian-owned authentic Asian market offering a wide selection of Asian and western foods, including live seafood, exotic fruits, hard-to-find vegetables, fresh dairy, and a bakery department. It operates a loyalty club card and runs weekly specials, making it a value-oriented stop for resupply. A second location has opened in Richmond, indicating a growing regional presence.
